sourceTracingAudit.method: The value of an input corpus is that its states come from the source rather than from the author's imagination, so every one of the twenty-three was traced to the clause of G07 v3 exactByteIntent its source field cites, and the per-class sets were compared for both omission and invention.
sourceTracingAudit.ev1HostileArchive: G07 v3 EV-1 enumerates eight file-04 hazard classes in a parenthetical: traversal, absolute, device, FIFO, socket, escaping symlink, hostile hard-link, sparse-as-full. The eight archive states are an exact set match after normalisation. Nothing added, nothing missed.
sourceTracingAudit.ev2HostilePath: EV-2 names case, Unicode and link aliases. The three path states cover all three. The Unicode state is named 'executed-tree Unicode alias', which is the limb EV-2 records as independently scorable, and its source field carries EV-2's own boundary — that pathRule / RJ-3 Unicode-norm-duplicate remains OBL-UNICODE-NORM on DR-103 and is not scored here.
sourceTracingAudit.ev3HostileLoader: This was the one that needed care. EV-3's clause reads 'PATH/loader/shell/live-project/system-runtime/install-time substitution or loader/entrypoint replacement', which admits either a maximal reading of eight limbs with loader appearing twice, or a union reading of seven distinct terms. The artifact names seven, and I tested which reading it used: each of the seven distinct source terms — PATH, loader, shell, live-project, system-runtime, install-time, entrypoint — appears in exactly one state, none twice and none absent. That is the union, and it is the better reading: substituting the loader and replacing the loader are the same hazard, so producing both would have been an invented extra rather than completeness. The artifact also states the reading openly in whatIsAuthored as 'seven substitution/replacement limbs'.
sourceTracingAudit.ev4Toctou: EV-4 names race records at extract, canonicalize, verify-to-spawn and concurrent update/remove, including directory/inode swap between verification and spawn. All five appear as five states, the last carrying EV-4's full qualifier.
sourceTracingAudit.arithmetic: whatIsAuthored claims eight, three, seven and five; the artifact holds 8 + 3 + 7 + 5 = 23 states, and the count is what is present.
sourceTracingAudit.classFidelity: The four class names equal G07 v3's namedCorpusNotAuthored exactly, and every state's classMemberVerbatim and assertsNamedNotAuthored name its own class.

independence.theRiskThisCycle: The dominant risk was the opposite of the previous three cycles. Having just rejected three input corpora on one defect, the cheap outcome would have been a fourth rejection by pattern. The defect simply is not present here, and I checked rather than assumed by tracing all twenty-three states to source and comparing per-class sets in both directions. The secondary risk was then over-correcting into acceptance-by-relief — passing an artifact quickly because it clears the bar the others failed — so I ran the invention tests as carefully as the omission ones, and the EV-3 reading question took the longest single check in this review.
independence.residualRisk: I set the standard these four corpora were measured against, in the G16 verdict. A reviewer who had not would be better placed to say whether the standard is the right one; I can only report that it is satisfiable, and that this artifact satisfies it.

coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Twenty attacks run, none landed. Custody holds: subject 6d863808 at 0444, 10588 bytes, unmoved at both ends; HEAD never left 5d5d778 and the artifact's head equals it; live required-now 26 of 26; live DR-103 token OPEN; file 08 and COORD unmodified. All seven cited pins reproduce and the artifact's seven 64-hex strings are exactly those pins. This is the input corpus the document class is supposed to produce, and the contrast with my three preceding rejections is worth stating plainly: where those held a slug, the class name and a marker, this holds twenty-three distinct initial states across the four classes, each with its own stateNamed and its own cited source clause. So that standard is satisfiable, and the earlier verdicts read as measurements of those artifacts rather than a bar on the class. Because an input corpus is only worth what its fidelity is worth, I traced every one of the twenty-three to the G07 v3 clause it cites and compared each class set in both directions. EV-1's eight file-04 hazard classes — traversal, absolute, device, FIFO, socket, escaping symlink, hostile hard-link, sparse-as-full — match the eight archive states as an exact set. EV-2's case, Unicode and link aliases are all present, and the Unicode state carries EV-2's own boundary that pathRule / RJ-3 Unicode-norm-duplicate remains OBL-UNICODE-NORM on DR-103 and is not scored. EV-4's five race sites are all present with the last carrying the full directory/inode-swap qualifier. EV-3 needed the most care and was the longest check in the review: its clause admits either eight limbs with loader counted twice or seven distinct terms, and I tested which reading was used — each of PATH, loader, shell, live-project, system-runtime, install-time and entrypoint appears in exactly one state, none twice and none absent. That union is the faithful decomposition, since substituting the loader and replacing the loader are one hazard described twice, and the artifact declares the reading openly as seven substitution/replacement limbs rather than leaving it implicit. The prohibitions hold under value testing, not keyword testing. Zero filesystem type names of any kind, with filesystemsStanding the literal UNPOPULATED, matching the qualifier all four EV members carry. Zero treeRootDigest values, respecting EV-3's per-entry-not-treeRootDigest rule. Zero fixture paths and NOT-AUTHORED on all twenty-three states. Zero SATISFIED and zero QUALIFIED. The two DR-103 leftovers it must not take — the unicode-norm-duplicate fixture and Windows-only TC-PATH — are both disclaimed, and the gate join pinned here holds OBL-G07-FX-AUTHORING at leftoverDesign true on DR-G07, which I read at source. Disclosure: all three Claude-lane verdicts this corpus pins are my lane's and one is mine from earlier today, and I set the standard these four corpora were measured against in the G16 verdict. The risk this cycle ran opposite to the last three — a fourth rejection by pattern would have been the cheap outcome — so I ran the invention tests as carefully as the omission ones rather than passing quickly on relief.
